# linux_systemctl (Action)

Runs a systemctl command, such as restarting a service after its configuration changed. Requires Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "linux_systemctl" "reload_nginx" {
  config {
    command = "reload"
    unit    = "nginx.service"
  }
}

resource "linux_file" "nginx_site" {
  path    = "/etc/nginx/conf.d/app.conf"
  content = file("${path.module}/app.conf")

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.linux_systemctl.reload_nginx]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) systemctl command: `start`, `stop`, `restart`, `reload`, `reload-or-restart`, `try-restart`, `try-reload-or-restart`, `enable`, `disable`, `mask`, `unmask`, `daemon-reload`.

### Optional

- `unit` (String) Unit the command applies to. Required, except for `daemon-reload`.
